name: biomanager
description: Tell your assistant what you did in the lab, in your words or with a photo of your notes; it proposes the records in your lab's BioManager, and you approve them there.

interface.longDescription:
BioManager keeps a lab's animals, stocks and notebook in one place: mice, zebrafish, flies, worms, plasmids, samples, reagents and experiments. It is open source, and each lab runs its own, on a desktop or a lab server.

This plugin teaches the assistant to work with your lab's BioManager. Tell it what you did, in your words or with a photo of your notes, and it looks up each record and sends one proposal, which you approve in BioManager; it never changes anything itself. It can also answer questions about your records, and plan with numbers BioManager works out from them: breeding, animals per group, random groups, a whole experiment.

Connect your own BioManager too: Help → Connect an AI assistant in BioManager shows its address, which you add as a custom MCP server.
